501.name: Q501 Proof of Clan Alliance (clan level 3 -> 4: Alliance Manifesto 3874)
501.source: Q00501_ProofOfClanAlliance.java. Clan leader of a clan of EXACTLY level 3. 3 clan members (not the leader) of level 40+. Reward: Alliance Manifesto + 120,000 SP.

steps.text: Clan leader: Sir Kristof Rodemai (Giran) -> start the quest (30756-07).
Clan leader: Witch Kalis (Forest of Evil, gatekeeper "Forest of Evil") -> 30759-03: she asks for 3 Symbols of Loyalty.

3 clan members (NOT the leader), level 40+: talk to the Statue of Offering next to Kalis (95348,22298). 50 %: a Symbol of Loyalty at once; otherwise the statue kills you ("Die You Fool") and you get it when dead (res afterwards). The datapack gives the symbol to the MEMBER while Kalis checks the LEADER for 3 — verify on L2Toggle how the symbols reach the leader.
Clan leader at Kalis with 3 Symbols: gets the Antidote Recipe List and is poisoned (Poison of Death, a FATAL timed poison). Everything below must be done before it kills him.
A clan member at Athrea (Hunters Valley, 102069,103120): the box game — 16 Boxes of Athrea, kill until 4 say "BINGO" -> Blood of Eva (retry costs 10,000 adena).

Kill for herbs (10 % each, party members with the quest): Oel Mahum Witch Doctor (lvl 55, Outlaw Forest near Oren), Harit Lizardman Shaman (lvl 54, Forest of Mirrors / Hunters), Vanor Silenos Shaman (lvl 49, near Aden).
Clan leader, STILL poisoned, at Kalis with Blood of Eva + the 3 herbs -> Voucher of Faith + Potion of Recovery.
Clan leader: Sir Kristof Rodemai -> Alliance Manifesto + 120,000 SP.
Clan level 3 -> 4 (1,000,000 SP + Alliance Manifesto) with !clanlevel.

503.name: Q503 Pursuit of Clan Ambition (clan level 4 -> 5: Seal of Aspiration 3870)
503.source: Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition.java. Clan leader of a level-4 clan; members can help (kills count for the leader in a party). Reward: Seal of Aspiration + 250,000 SP. Monsters level 54-65.

steps.text: Clan leader: Sir Gustav Athebaldt (Oren castle town) -> start, Gustav's 1st letter.
Clan leader: Martien (Giran) with the letter.

Dragon Valley: Corpses of Fritz / Lutz / Kurtz (64819,115911 · 65205,109495 · 64113,103060) give eggs and spawn Blitz Wyrms; kill Drakes (lvl 57) and Thunder Wyrms (lvl 54) for Mist Drake / Drake / Thunder Wyrm eggs (10 each) and Blitz Wyrm eggs (10). Kurtz gives the Brooch of the Magpie. Party level ~55+.
Clan leader: Head Blacksmith Kusto (Giran) with the Brooch -> Black Anvil Coin.
Clan leader: Martien with all eggs.
Clan leader: Gustav -> 2nd letter.

Balthazar (117380,75616, near Hunters Village) with the Black Anvil Coin -> Recipe: Spiteful Soul Energy; kill Spiteful Soul Leaders (lvl 65, Necropolis of Disciples area 178231,-25856) for 10 Spiteful Soul Energy -> back to Balthazar.

Gustav -> 3rd letter; Sir Eric Rodemai (Aden, 147456,27488); Witch Cleo (160611,21236); Imperial Tomb: Grave Guards (lvl 54) spawn Grave Keymasters -> 6 Imperial Keys; Imperial Gravekeeper (lvl 60); the Imperial Coffer -> Scepter of Judgment.
Clan leader: Gustav with the Scepter -> Seal of Aspiration + 250,000 SP.
Clan level 4 -> 5 (2,500,000 SP + Seal of Aspiration) with !clanlevel.

bloodmark.name: Blood Mark (clan level 2 -> 3)
bloodmark.source: Blood Queen (npc 18001, level 60, aggressive, 1933 HP): death drop group 20 % -> Blood Mark 100 % (npcstats/18000-18099.xml). 22 spawns: 11 around Aden -> Seal of Shilen (185766,14106 and 186546,24148), 8 near the Devastated Castle (178328,6640), 3 near Antharas Fortress (81262,106319). No quest, no multisell in the datapack gives it (verify: L2Toggle may sell it in a shop / the Community Board).

steps.target: Blood Queen (lvl 60) at Seal of Shilen
steps.text: A party whose lowest level is 55+ hunts Blood Queens around Aden -> Seal of Shilen until someone has a Blood Mark (20 % per kill). Send to that PARTY. The danger check refuses the teleport if the monsters there are > team max + 6.
Trade the Blood Mark to the clan leader (Dagger1). Trades between different parties need your OK.
Clan level 2 -> 3 (350,000 SP + Blood Mark) with !clanlevel. Needs clan level 2 first.
